scene.note: The log moves off the torn-out pages and into files on the laptop, which your functions read, start and add to.

steps.note: Ailsa asks for a log file by its path.
The file is opened, read once from start to end, and closed.
Everything in it comes back as one text, line ends included.
The file gives one line at a time, each with what ends it.
Each line is tidied, and blank lines are dropped.
A list of the entries comes back, in order.
A new night starts, with a title for its log.
The file is opened for writing, which empties it, or makes it if it is not there.
It now holds only the title line, ended properly.
An entry comes in from the radio desk.
The file is opened for adding, so what it holds stays.
The entry lands on a line of its own at the end, ready for the next one.
Ailsa asks for the log of one night.
The folder and the night's file name are joined into one path, and the file is looked for.
That night's entries come back, or nothing for a night with no log.
